Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines

walk noun

classical

ambulātiō, ambulātiōnis f.

noun, third declension

Examples

  • omnis enim ambulātiō lapidem aliquem reddit, quō fit ut pater sinūs lapidibus plēnōs domum referat

    for every walk yields some stone, and so Dad brings home pockets full of stonesLibellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

See also fork in the road, this way, that way, pocket, stone, path, walk.

SourcesLewis & Short: ambulatio
